cards.title: Act Like You Belong
cards.instruction: You do not understand what is happening. Copy the confidence around you and never admit confusion.

cards.title: Retroactive Permission
cards.instruction: Get approval for something you have already done.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You raised your auction paddle so decisively that I raised mine. You'll agree the wardrobe I just bought is a good choice?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I was scratching my ear. You've spent our sofa money.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Of course. An opening move on storage. We can approve the wardrobe and choose a sofa that fits beside it.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: That was the wardrobe delivery charge. The wardrobe costs another two hundred.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Naturally, delivery first. Would you approve the two hundred too, so the delivery we've bought has something to bring?
